ValidationRule.description: SCRUM-467: on a deal that was already won or lost before this save the offer dates stay as they are; an edit may not change them. Renewal on an open deal is unaffected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISCHANGED(StageName)), OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost")), OR(ISCHANGED(Offer_Sent_On__c), ISCHANGED(Offer_Valid_Until__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The deal is already closed - the offer dates stay as they are and cannot be changed any more.
